subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
TB Solution: 

The correct answer is as fast as.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• 'as fast as' means able to move or act at great speed.

 -Example: He leapt up it as fast as he could, firing his last two revolver shots into the giant creature's head.

 
• to express that the speed of two things is equivalent/similar, 'as fast as' would be correct.

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• "as slowly as" means moving, doing something or happening without much speed; not fast.
 
• "as much as" means to say that two things are equal in amount or degree.
 
• "as many as" means used to show surprise at how large a number of people or things is.

Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in is 'as fast as'
